claim_summaries: Exact mapping of the admitted easy-plane XXZ-with-fields class to a hard-core-boson model with |V_e| <= 2 t_e, arbitrary rational chemical potentials, and nonpositive real source fields.

Conditional grand-canonical partition FPRAS, computational-basis Gibbs sampling, logarithmic-subsystem reconstruction, and a restricted BPP local-Hamiltonian promise result, all inherited from the existing XXZ reduction and Chen-Liu theorem.
Canonical charge-sector extension is unresolved; only a bounded finite diagnostic is available.
